scope.question: Does one exact UK policy, defence, investment, convening, procurement, review, or implementation instrument materially connect Matt Clifford and Anduril?

sources.title: Experts to lead AI Safety Summit preparations
supports: Clifford was appointed a Prime Minister's Representative charged with rallying countries, companies and experts and coordinating summit preparation
the role was separate from his ARIA chairmanship
does_not_support: Anduril participation selected or directed by Clifford
procurement, investment, award or deployment authority

sources.title: DSIT ministerial meetings, October to December 2023
subjects: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
supports: Anduril participated in a 17 October 2023 techUK and DSIT roundtable about the AI Safety Summit
Anduril also appeared in the Secretary of State's broad frontier-AI-safety roundtable on the same date
Matt Clifford appeared separately in a 25 October 2023 investor roundtable about AI
does_not_support: a decision or benefit caused by either event

sources.title: Governance of artificial intelligence oral evidence, 8 November 2023
supports: Clifford described the summit role as a limited tour of duty ending after the summit
the testimony identifies his summit remit and private-sector background

sources.title: MOD awards £3.8 million TALOS contract
supports: Anduril's UK defence operating relationship predates Clifford's AI Safety Summit and Action Plan roles
the award route ran through MOD Strategic Command and jHub

sources.title: £17 million TALOS Phase 3 contract
supports: a further Anduril UK defence contract announced during the AI Safety Summit period
the named public pathway remained UK Strategic Command's TALOS programme
does_not_support: Clifford authorship, selection, influence or approval
a causal connection between the summit and the contract

sources.title: Appointment of Matt Clifford as AI Opportunities Adviser
supports: Clifford's later unpaid advisory remit over implementation, sector growth, talent, leading-company engagement and sovereign AI capability

sources.title: DBT ministerial meetings, April to June 2025
supports: Anduril had a documented 19 May 2025 government engagement concerning defence spending, foreign direct investment and innovation
does_not_support: a connection to his advisory office

sources.title: Chequers guests, April to June 2025
supports: Anduril participated in a London Tech Week lunch at Chequers alongside many technology and investment representatives
does_not_support: a decision, recommendation, procurement or benefit

sources.title: Anduril Industries UK Ltd company record
supports: the exact UK legal entity for Anduril's British operations
does_not_support: the operating role in any specific contract

searched_surfaces: published DSIT ministerial meeting registers for the summit period
published MOD and DBT contract and meeting records
search_denominator.scope_limit: The denominator is limited to the frozen published public record and cannot establish the absence of unpublished meetings, submissions, correspondence or conflict records.
